text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Catalan leader Pujol only guarantees support for government until May 1998
DIARIO 16
- Government spokesman Rodriguez lied
ABC
- New attorney general Jesus Cardenal sworn in before King Juan Carlos
CINCO DIAS
- Iberia retires its old 727 planes
- Foreigners make stock market profits of half a trillion pesetas in one year
- CPI revision cuts rise in pensions
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Unemployed fall by 49,400 thanks to economic recovery
- Argentaria and Santander manage Endesa public share offering
- Equity funds earn biggest yield to March
